title: How do you feel? Ma olen + adjective vs Mul on + noun
explanation:
Feelings and states are said in two different ways.
Ma olen + adjective (I am ...): Ma olen väsinud / unine / kurb / rõõmus / vihane / õnnelik / üllatunud / armunud / terve / haige. Also Ma olen närvis / mures / hirmul / segaduses.
Mul on + noun or state word (lit. 'at me is'): Mul on janu / hirm / stress / palavik. Mul on paha / piinlik / kiire / külm. Mul on kõht täis / tühi.
QuestionYesNo
Kas sa oled unine?Jah, olen küll.Ei, ei ole.
Kas sul on janu?Jah, on küll.Ei, ei ole.
Kas su pea valutab?Jah, valutab küll. / Natuke valutab.Ei, ei valuta.
General question: Kuidas sa ennast tunned? – Mul on kõik korras / hästi.

title: sa, sinu (su), sul: you, your, you have
explanation:
The pronoun sina / sa (you) changes form depending on its job in the sentence:
formmeaningexample
sa (sina)you (subject)Sa oled metsas ja näed karu.
sinu (su)yourSinu laps nutab. Sinu köögis on hiir.
sul (sinul)you have / at youSul on homme sünnipäev. Sul on kiire.
Tip: if the English is you have / you are in a hurry / you have a birthday → sul on. If a noun follows that belongs to you → sinu / su. If 'you' does something → sa + verb with -d (sa oled, sa lähed, sa näed).

title: Mu pea valutab vs Mul on köha (aches and illnesses)
explanation:
Something hurts: mu / minu + body part (nominative) + valutab: Mu pea valutab. Mu kurk valutab. With a plural body part: Mu silmad valutavad.
Questions: Mis sul valutab? (What hurts?) Kas su ... valutab? – Jah, valutab küll. / Ei, ei valuta.
You have an illness: mul on + noun: Mul on nohu / köha / palavik / allergia.
Fixed expressions (learn as a whole):
  • Mul on süda paha. (I feel nauseous)
  • Mul käib pea ringi. (I feel dizzy)
  • Mul on kõht lahti / kinni. (diarrhoea / constipation)
  • Mul jookseb nina verd. (my nose is bleeding)
You are something: ma olen + adjective: Ma olen haige / rase / väsinud / vaktsineeritud.
General question: Mis sul viga on? (What's wrong?)

title: If I were ...: Kui ma oleks ..., ma ...
explanation:
Unreal 'if' sentences use the conditional in both parts: Kui + conditional, + conditional.
Kui ma oleks värv, ma oleks sinine. (If I were a colour, I'd be blue.)
Kui mul oleks palju vaba aega, ma õpiks eesti keelt. (If I had a lot of free time, I'd study Estonian.)
'I would have' = mul oleks (never *mul oleksin*); 'I wouldn't have' = mul ei oleks + partitive: kui sul ei oleks arvutit.
Questions: Mida sa teeks, kui ...? Kui sa oleks loom, kes sa oleks? Mida sa ostaks, kui sul oleks 100 eurot?
Joke saying: Kui tädil oleks rattad, oleks ta omnibuss. ('If my aunt had wheels, she'd be a bus' – i.e. 'if ifs and buts...').

title: Impersonal: Siin jalutatakse (people do / it is done)
explanation:
The impersonal (umbisikuline tegumood) says that something is done without saying who does it – like English 'people ...' or 'it is done'. One form for everyone, ending -takse / -dakse (sometimes -akse).
Regular verbs: da-infinitive minus -da/-ta + -takse: jaluta-da → jalutatakse, mängi-da → mängitakse, vaada-ta → vaadatakse, puha-ta → puhatakse, pes-ta → pestakse.

explanation:
Mixed review of the forms practised in the Kordamine section.
  • Compliments: adjective agrees with the noun – plural with plural: Sul on ilusad sinised püksid! Sul on väga ilusad pikad juuksed!
  • Recipes use the sina-imperative (1st person present minus -n): keedan → Keeda!, koorin → Koori!, lõikan → Lõika!, valan → Vala!, lisan → Lisa!, segan → Sega!, maitsen → Maitse!, söön → Söö!
  • Quantities take the partitive: 400 g kartuleid, 1 l keefirit, 100 g sinki.
  • Where? → -s / -l: kesklinnas, kolmandal korrusel. When? → talvel, kahe päeva pärast.
  • Past negative: Mida sa eile ei teinud? Conditional: Kellena sa tahaksid töötada?

examples.et: Sul on nii armas väike nina!
examples.en: You have such a cute little nose!

examples.et: Keeda ja koori kartulid ja munad.
examples.en: Boil and peel the potatoes and eggs.

examples.et: Korter asub kesklinnas, kolmandal korrusel.
examples.en: The flat is in the city centre, on the third floor.

examples.et: Kellena sa tahaksid töötada?
examples.en: What would you like to work as?
